user.title: Set up UEM
user.description: Choose the existing E3DC-RSCP integration. UEM starts exclusively in shadow mode. Without an adapter you can use manual entity mapping.

confirm.title: Confirm detected measurements

data.max_charge_manual_power_w: Max charging power as fixed value (W)

data_description.soc_entity: The entity that reports the battery's current state of charge (e.g. 50 = 50%).
data_description.pv_power_entity: The PV system entity that reports the currently generated power.
data_description.house_power_entity: The house power consumption entity. A negative value is allowed and means that e.g. a balcony power station is currently producing more than the house consumes.
data_description.battery_charge_entity: The battery power entity. A single sensor that can deliver positive or negative values depending on direction (charging/discharging).
data_description.battery_capacity_entity: The entity that reports the installed battery capacity in kWh. Optional — alternatively you can enter a fixed value.
data_description.battery_manual_capacity_kwh: The installed battery capacity as a fixed value in kWh. Optional — alternatively you can select an entity.
data_description.max_charge_power_entity: The entity that reports the battery's maximum charging power in watts. Optional — alternatively you can enter a fixed value.
data_description.max_charge_manual_power_w: The maximum charging power as a fixed value in watts. Optional — alternatively you can select an entity.
data_description.grid_export_entity: The grid power entity. A single sensor that maps import and export via a single number.
data_description.invert_grid_power_sign: Enable if your grid power entity reports the opposite sign convention from what UEM expects.

no_e3dc_choice.title: No E3DC-RSCP adapter found
no_e3dc_choice.description: You can manually assign the measurements now or create UEM without input in safe shadow mode. An incomplete setup calculates and controls nothing and can be extended later via **Configure**.
